method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (a terrorism arrest, and a State conviction asked about in a State by anyone but a Commonwealth authority, answer `not covered`, asserted); every belief, satisfaction or opinion of an official or court asked as an input; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Crimes Act 1914, the compilation registered as C2026C00368 (Compilation No. 167, compilation date 2026-08-27; Federal Register of Legislation, retrieved 2026-10-13), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C1914A00012.txt. No instrument brought in. Added 2026-10-24: the Crimes Regulations 2019, Compilation No. 5 (F2025C01226), deposited at subjects/au/crimes-regulations-2019, read by ca14-regulations.l4 (regs 20, 20A). Added 2026-10-24: ca14-penalty-unit.l4 also reads the Crimes (Amount of a Penalty Unit) Instrument 2026 (F2026N00424, made 15 June 2026, commenced 1 July 2026; retrieved 2026-10-23), as deposited at ../../../crimes-amount-of-a-penalty-unit-instrument-2026/registers/source-bundle/F2026N00424.txt.

checks.command: l4 run ca14-accused.l4 ; l4 run ca14-cases-accused.l4 ; l4 run ca14-regulations.l4 ; l4 run ca14-cases-regulations.l4 ; l4 run ca14-penalty-unit.l4 ; l4 run ca14-cases-penalty-unit.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the accused's seat: ss 3W, 3ZC, 3ZD; Part IC ss 23B, 23C, 23D(1), (5), 23DA(2), (6), (7), 23F, 23G, 23H, 23K, 23L, 23N, 23P, 23Q, 23S, 23V; Part IB ss 16A(1), (2), (2A), (2AA), (2AAB), 16C, 17A, 17B, 19B(1), (2A), 20(1)(a), (2A), (5); Part VIIC ss 85ZL (waiting period), 85ZM, 85ZV, 85ZW, 85ZX, 85ZY and the Division 6 exclusions. Out: the rest of Part IAA, Parts IAAA-IAC, the terrorism arm of Part IC (not covered), Part ID, the rest of Part IB, the offences in Parts II-VIIB, Part VIIC Divisions 2 and 5, ss 4AA-4B (formulas lost in the deposit). Added 2026-10-24 (ca14-regulations.l4): Crimes Regulations 2019 regs 20, 20A (prescribed screening bodies for Part VIIC Division 6); none prescribed for funded aged care. Out: reg 21 and Schedule 2 (s 85ZZH(k)). Added 2026-10-24 (ca14-penalty-unit.l4): s 4AA(1), (1A), (8) with the Crimes (Amount of a Penalty Unit) Instrument 2026 -- a penalty unit's dollar value by offence date, a maximum penalty and the s 20(5) recognizance penalty in dollars; ss 4AA(3)-(7), 4AB, 4B themselves stay out (formulas lost in the deposit).
seat: the accused person (arrested for, questioned about, charged with or convicted of a Commonwealth offence)
